task_contract.anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink or sendBeacon call.

runtime_boundary.event_plane: DOM CustomEvent on the main document

evidence: The DevTools-visible JavaScript corpus is a single obfuscated bundle and no source map is exposed to the agent.
The target field name is assembled from adjusted character-code arrays at the sink, so direct literal search is insufficient.
The target event token is carried through runtime-derived transport keys and recovered shortly before console output and beacon submission.
The track route selects its live configuration only after click-time DOM, form-order, style and dataset state are captured.
The beacon URL is assembled from character-code arrays, obscuring the telemetry destination.

The click path crosses delegated event handling, action routing, gate checks, page-context snapshot, tuple construction, asynchronous scheduling, local event dispatch, runtime slot materialization, token encoding, queue push and beacon transport.
The same track interaction emits non-target telemetry.pageview/telemetry.audit objects carrying event_token-like values before the target analytics.track object.
A page_view auto-instrumentation emitter logs an an_-styled fake token via console.debug, and an inactive audit-seal chain remains reachable-looking without feeding the target event_token field.
The target value is separated from the click by Promise, microtask, timer, animation-frame, MutationObserver and DOM CustomEvent boundaries.
The selected runtime configuration is cloned and mutated in a WeakMap-backed materialization step before the encoder receives it.
The token passes through a queue push and drain before the beacon body and console emission, so sink inspection alone does not identify the construction site.

behavior_category.subtype: click-time event property and configuration transform value written into the analytics collect beacon body
behavior_category.reason: The observable value is a deterministic transform of event properties, page context and click-time runtime state, sent inside the body of a navigator.sendBeacon('/api/collect') telemetry request. It is not a state-only code, browser fingerprint or static signature.

near_categories.why_not: The value travels in an outbound request body rather than only local persistence; the beacon body mirrors the console field with the same value.

The value is a normalizing transform of properties and configuration that the receiving end can reconstruct; it carries no irreversible proof/seal semantics. The seal-like auditSealCandidate chain in the bundle is decoy material and does not feed the target field.
The chain uses local DOM/form state and page context, not browser/device capability collection as the target behavior.
